intro.heading: Welcome to myNextDays.
intro.p1: A full property management system plus channel manager — for hotels, agencies and holiday rental hosts. Independent and fair, instead of corporate complexity and enterprise pricing.
intro.p2: Increase your occupancy, simplify daily work and create great guest experiences — without the complexity and the enterprise pricing of the big systems.
intro.p3: Everything in one place, smart automation and connections to every important channel — plus your own low-commission booking portal. Your business grows with more control and less effort.

ki.heading: The platform takes the routine off your hands.
ki.sub: Run it hands-free, let guest questions answer themselves, keep rates moving — without learning a single click path.

voice.title: Avatar / voice control
voice.text: Run it hands-free by voice and let an avatar answer: check occupancy, manage bookings and tasks, change rates – while you are on the road or getting a property ready.

concierge.title: An AI concierge for your guests
concierge.text: The digital guest guide answers the Wi-Fi password, the key box, the bins and local tips by itself — in 24 languages, around the clock.

preise.title: Rates that think along
preise.text: Set a base rate with a minimum and maximum per property; nightly rates follow season, occupancy and demand. Manual rates always take precedence.

ki.blaseAntwort: 18 of 24 nights booked. Two gaps at the weekend — lower the rate?

integrationen.heading: 56 booking platforms – one interface.
integrationen.p1: Through our connectivity partner Channex you distribute availability, rates and restrictions to 56 booking platforms — including Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, Vrbo, Google, Agoda and Tripadvisor. Two-way sync in real time: a booking on one portal blocks that night everywhere else.
integrationen.p2: On top of that comes your own distribution: the low-commission booking portal on myNextDays, a booking widget for your website and regional channels you can switch on individually. Every channel is controlled separately — you decide where a property is visible.
integrationen.cta: Connect channels in the free trial

einblicke.heading: How myNextDays actually works
einblicke.sub: Not illustrations — captures from a live operation with real bookings from every channel.

hotel.title: Hotels and holiday rentals in one interface
hotel.text: Every room is its own bookable unit — the same model as a holiday home. The occupancy board shows arrivals, stays and departures per unit, with occupancy, revenue and average nightly rate for the period.

objekte.title: Visibility per channel, not one switch for everything
objekte.text: Website, marketplace and booking portals are three separate axes. A property can stay live on your own site while it is paused on the portals — visible at a glance, switched in one click.

kanaele.title: Connect portals and keep your own direct channel
kanaele.text: Booking.com, Airbnb and other portals share the same availability as your direct bookings. A booked night blocks everywhere — no double bookings, no manual reconciliation.
